data.cultural_impact: The name "Zidan" holds deep cultural significance in the Arab world. It is derived from the Arabic word "zad" which means "to add" or "to provide" or "to gain." In a broader sense, it represents the concept of achieving success, attaining a victory, and gaining honor, respect, and wealth. In sports, the term "zidan" is used to describe a goal or a point scored, reflecting the name's significance as a symbol of success and achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name "Zidan" carries spiritual significance as well. It is believed to represent a precious gift or a reward bestowed upon an individual by Allah, the Almighty God. The term "zidan" appears in the Quran in Surah Al-Rad, verse 28, where it is used to describe the reward given to the Prophet Moses for his steadfastness and devotion to Allah. Hence, the name "Zidan" is not only a symbol of worldly success but also a reminder of the spiritual rewards and blessings bestowed by Allah upon those who persevere and remain steadfast in their faith.
